disclosure: Diagnostic only — not a published SLO.
interpretation: Buffered put is only 11.8% of pure-Blake ops/s — NOT Blake-bound (Blake is far faster).
Memory put 595712 ops/s vs Buffered 31717 — large gap ⇒ time spent in segment OS write path (stall/wait), not only index CPU.
Raw write_all 752251 ops/s vs Buffered put 31717 — store adds 23.7× wall vs raw same-size writes.
Low process %CPU + low disk gauges with large Memory→Buffered gap = classic blocking I/O wait (thread not runnable), not pure compute.
